gzhir gnas ky-i byang sems gdan gsum tshang ba'i dam tshig pa de la byin te thim pas nyams myong gi ye shes gdan gsum tshang ba zhig skye bar gyur pa ni gsang dbang gi gdan gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dus su slob ma'i lus dang yi ge bha ga dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gdan gsum tshang ba la sngar gsang dbang bskur ba de gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya gdan gsum tshang ba byin te/ snyoms par zhugs pa las slob ma'i byang sems gdan gsum tshang ba de dbab pa dang gzung ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas nyams myong dpe'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba ni sher dbang gi gdan gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /bzhi pa bskur ba'i tshe slob ma'i snying po ye shes kyi rlung gdan gsum tshang ba la tshig gi bzhi pa'am don gyi bzhi pa'am bzhi pa rten can bskur te ngo sprad pas sngar las kyang mchog tu gyur pa'i dpe'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba ni dbang bzhi pa gdan gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /de ltar na de dag thams cad kyi sbyang gzhi gsal ba 'khor ba/ sbyong byed stong pa myang 'das/ sbyang gzhi de sbyong byed der ngo 'phrod pa ni dbyer med do/ /gnyis pa lam 'khor 'das dbyer med la gsum las/ bskyed rim 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ bskyed pa sngon 'gro rten dang bskyed chog dang*/ kha dog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur yan lag bcas/ /re re'ang 'khor 'das dbyer med rang bzhin du/ /legs par brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pas las dang nyon mongs sbyong zhing sngon ston pas bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa de'i dod grub cing de lam du byed/ srung ba'i 'khor los bar chad srung zhing srod la bdud btul ba lam du byed/ chos 'byung bsgoms pas nam mkha'i khams dang mngal skyes kyi mngal la sogs pa skye gnas bzhi'i gang du skye ba'i gnas sbyong zhing rnam thar sgo gsum lam du byed/

'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyis phyi snod kyi 'byung ba dang nang lus kyi 'byung bzhi sbyong zhing tshad med bzhi lam du byed/ gzhal yas khang gis ma dag snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong zhing byang phyogs so bdun lam du byed/ mngon byang lnga'i nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pas skye gnas bzhi sbyong zhing ye shes lnga lam du byed/ kha dog ni dkar pos gti mug sbyong zhing me long lta bu'i ye shes mtshon/ nag pos zhe sdang sbyong zhing chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mtshon/ dmar pos 'dod chags sbyong zhing sor rtog ye shes mtshon/ ser pos nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyong zhing mnyam nyid ye shes mtshon/ ljang gus phrag dog sbyong zhing bya grub ye shes mtshon pas lha'i sku mdog la sogs pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod cing bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa ye shes su byin gyis brlabs/ phyag mtshan ni/ 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams ni rim bzhin spang bya'i ngos nas gti mug sogs dang chos mthun zhing 'bras bu me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs de dang de mtshon zhing*/ srog chags kyi phyag mtshan rnams ni mtshon byed bzang ba yin te/ re re la'ang phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga dang ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed thams cad tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /phyag mtshan 'khor lo la sogs pas chog mod kyang 'dir phyag bcu drug gi phyag mtshan dang*/ zhabs 'og tu bdud bzhi mnan pa rnams ni sngon byung gi rnam 'phrul la dgongs te he ru ka byon tshul las shes par bya'o/ /phyag dang zhabs brkyangs pas ni chos nyid stong pa nyid kun la khyab pa dang snying rjes 'gro don mdzad pa mtshon/ bskums pas bdag de bzhin nyid dang ldan zhing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mtshon/ phyag thugs kar bsnol ba dang zhabs skyil krung gis thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'jug pa mtshon no/

/de ltar na sngar bshad pa de kun gyi sbyang gzhir snang ba 'khor ba/ de dang de'i sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa/ ngo bo zung du 'jug pa dbyer med do/ /lam gyi yan lag bzlas pa dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ khrus dang spyod lam la sogs pa'i bya ba thabs kyi phyogs ni chos can 'khor ba dang chos mthun la/ lta ba brjod bral dang ma bral ba'i shes rab rnams chos nyid mya ngan las 'das pa dang chos mthun zhing phan tshun rgyas thebs pa dbyer med do/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ rdzogs pa lus dang ngag yid 'khor ba la/ /'bras bu ye

( kha ) shes sangs ( ka ) rgyas legs ( ga ) rdzogs par/ / ( kha ) rgyu dang 'bras bus ( ka ) phan tshun rgyas ( ga ) gdab cing*/ / rtogs pa dpe yi ye shes ngo sprod bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ sbyang gzhi lus rtsa dang rtsa yi ge dang khams bdud rtsi dang snying po ye shes rlung rnams ni 'khor ba yin la/ de dag sbyong byed spyi bo dang spyi gtsug sogs na bzhugs pa'i khaṇ+ḍa ka pa li dang rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa/ de gnyis rgyu la 'bras bu dang 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya ste phan tshun rgyas thebs pa ni lus 'khor 'das dbyer med/ de bzhin du rlung nang 'jug phyir 'gro gnas pa ste gsum dang*/ yi ge oṃ la sogs pa gsum/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa gsum/ sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ de dag 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes su gdod ma nas gnas par shes te nyams len gyi rtsis zin pa ni sbyong byed myang 'das/ mthar de gnyis dbyer med ro gcig tu rtogs pa ni ngag 'khor 'das dbyer med/ yid rnam par rtog pa du ma dang bcas pa 'khor ba/ sbyong byed rang byin rlabs sam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgoms pas sbyong ba ni myang 'das/ de la brten nas ye shes skyes pa ni yid 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /de ltar de dag 'khor 'das dbyer med de ngo 'phrod cing legs par rtogs pa'i tshe/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa la dpe'i ye shes yin no zhes ngo sprad par bya ste/ mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes mtshon nus pas so/ /gsum pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ /bskyed rdzogs thun mong chos drug dran bya zhing*/ /rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel 'dod na/ /dam tshig brda sogs la yang legs sbyar te/ /dri ma med pa'i blo yis dpyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo dang rab tu dbye ba dang ming gi don dang 'brel pa can du bsgom pa'i 'thad pa dang*/

rim pa gnyis kyis grol ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ rim gnyis bsgom tshul te thun mong gi chos drug 'khor 'das dbyer med du 'gro tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi rnam rtog gnyis dang sbyong byed rim pa gnyis sbyar nas nyams su len pa la brjod bral gyi lta bas rgyas thebs pa ni rim pa gnyis thun mong ba'i 'khor 'das dbyer med dang*/ dam tshig 'khor 'das dbyer med ni mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi skabs su bstan zin/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig lta ba yin pas sngar lta ba thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa dang*/ dpe'i ye shes kyi skabs su bstan zin/ bza' srung mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ni/ gnas skabs kyi bya ba yin pas 'khor ba ltar snang la/ ye shes skye ba'i grogs byed pas mya ngan las 'das par yang snang bas dbyer med do/ /brda ni lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa lta bu la sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa lnga phung po lnga dang de'i chos nyid rnam grangs pa dang drug sbyang ba la sbyong byed rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs dang drug sbyin pas 'bras bu rigs lnga ye shes lnga 'grub pa bum dbang gi brda 'khor 'das dbyer med/ de bzhin du brda gong ma rnams la yang dbang de dang de'i 'gros sbyar bas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de 'khor 'das dbyer med du shes par bya/ sogs kyis bsdus pa spyod lam dang nyal ba dang ldang ba dang*/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa la yang de dang de'i bya ba thams cad snang ba 'khor ba/ de dang de'i rang bzhin stong pa myang 'das/ snang stong zung 'jug tu rgyas gdab pa dbyer med de nyams su blang ba'i tshe dran pa gal che'o/ /gsum pa nyams myong 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ 'khor ba'i nyams la brten nas log lta spang*/ /lam gyi nyams kyis theg pa gcig tu bsgrub/ /'bras bu'i nyams kyis spro ba mchog tu 'gyur/ /chos kun tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la dbab/

/ces gsungs pa'i don ni/ lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis dang por rtsa yig rnams su rlung sems 'dus pa las/ rigs drug tha dad pa du ma'i nyams 'char/ de la brten nas las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing log par lta ba spong bar 'gyur/ yang bsgoms pa la brten nas rtsa yig rnams su rlung sems 'phro 'du las phyi nang gi lta grub tha dad pa'i tshul du snang ba 'char/ de la brten nas lta grub thams cad nyams snang yin par shes te/ yang dag par na theg pa gcig tu 'grub par 'gyur 'khor 'das dbyer med dam zung du 'jug pa kho na yin no zhes nges shes bskyed/ yang lam bsgoms pas rlung sems cher dwangs pa na yum dang rigs lnga'i rtsa yig tu rlung sems 'dus pas chos sku dang gzugs sku'i nyams 'char/ de la brten nas 'bras bu'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ro snyam du mos pa dang spro ba mchog tu 'gyur/ de ltar gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi nyams skye ba de ni nyams myong rjes su dran pa'i tshad ma yin/ de ltar bstan nas bla ma la mos gus khyad par can skye bas bla ma tshad ma/ de nyid sangs rgyas kyi lung dang 'byor bas lung tshad ma/ de nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gzhung rdo rje'i tshig dang 'phrod pas bstan bcos tshad ma zhes bya ba ste/ chos thams cad tshad ma bzhi ldan du gtan la dbab cing shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste/ /mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas gyur yin/ /des na lhun grub gnas gyur mi 'gal te/ /'di ni 'bras bu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ sprul sku longs sku chos sku ngo bo nyid sku ste sku bzhi/ shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang lha lus rtsa la sogs pa'i rten dkyil 'khor bzhi brten pa yid dang lnga la rang bzhin lhun grub tu gnas pa 'khor ba/

sku de dag sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas gnas 'gyur myang 'das/ sku re re'ang gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dang ma bral bas lhun grub dang gnas gyur mi 'gal ba 'bras bu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no zhes nges shes bskyed la da lta lam nyams su len pa'i dus su yang 'bras bu de dag gsal stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad cing nyams su blangs na lam chod che zhing gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum dbyer med kyi nyams len du 'gro ste/ de ltar yang bdag nyid chen pos/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med don smra ba/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes shākya'i sras po mchog /rdo rje'i rigs gcig kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po las gzhan don mthun smra ba su/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lta ba bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las/ lam du bskyed rim sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan zhes gsungs te/ dbang bzhi po re re lam gang yin pa/ lta ba gang yin pa/ grub mtha' gang yin pa/ 'da' ka ma gang yin pa/ zhar byung bar do gang yin pa/ 'bras bu gang yin pa ste don tshan drug drug gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa las/ dang po bum dbang gi lam ni bskyed pa'i rim pa/ lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba/ bar do bdag sems dang yi dam ro gcig pa/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste drug gi dang po lam bskyed pa'i rim pa la phyi bskyed rim dang nang bskyed rim gnyis/ dang po la/ sgom don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcad pa dang*/ bcad don nyams su blang ba gnyis/ dang po ni zin thun du 'chad do/ /gnyis pa la bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang sems 'dzin gnyis las/ dang po ni bsag sbyang 'jug gsum gong du bstan pa bzhin las maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i skabs kyi zhal shes ni/

bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ phyi kun rdzob kyi maṇ+ḍal/ nang rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal/ gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal te rim pa gsum gsungs pa'i dang po skabs 'dir dbul bar bya ste/ yang maṇ+ḍal bshams shing dbul la/ tshig ni/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'dir/ /dbus kyi ri rgyal ri rab la/ /gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan/ /nyi ma zla bas skor ba byed/ / lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal srid rin chen rnam pa bdun/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing*/ /ma rmos lo thog gser dang dngul/ /'bru bzang longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /dngos po bzang la gya nom pa/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ti wā ra maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod/ gzhan 'dra/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs kyi tshig /sku yi rdo rje sprul sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgro 'dogs yongs gcod phyi yi bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lus la bum dbang stsol/ /bskyed rim lam bzang sgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ /'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' snyoms par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na/ /gong nas gong du 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na/ /lha sems dbyer med bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub ste/ /sprul sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sbyar/ gnyis pa sems 'dzin la 'jug pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa'i rim pa/ ldang ba'i rim pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nas brtsams te mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi drug gang rung nyams su blang*/ de yang yan lag bzhi pa ltar na rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs kyi bar ram/

yan lag drug pa ltar na bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag gi bar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod cing*/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba bshar sgom gyi tshul du nyams len pa ste/ gsal ba ni sab sub ma yin par skad chung ngu'i sgo nas tshig ris gsal por brjod pa/ drag po ni tshig don gyi rjes su hril li li 'breng ste rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chad par bsgom/ de ltar byas na 'gor chung bas yun thung ba'ang shugs las 'byung bas rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gal che'o/ /gnyis pa gnas pa'i rim pa la nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ rnam pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ngo bo stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa la rnam pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i dpal kye rdo rje gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid de nga yin no snyam du yang dang yang du nga rgyal bya'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ / sangs rgyas nyid du myur bar 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rnam pa la bslab pa ni/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i rnam pa'am/ rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bur lam gyis dran par bya ste/ de ltar yang rdo rje gur las/ nga yi sku ni sgom byed pa/ /gal te sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rtsa zhal gyi spyan dbu ma la sems bzung ste/ rang kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mdzod spu'i dbus su spyan dbu ma khro bo'i spyan dbus gnag pa/ mtha' dkar ba/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ g.yas ngos su smin ma dang bcas shing rdzi ma dang bcas pa zhes yid kyis bsgom zhing sems gzung*/ de yang gsal ma thebs na ngag tu spyan dbu ma dbus gnag pa zhes sogs dal bu'i sgo nas brjod cing yang yang gsal gdab/

des kyang ma thebs na bris pa'i spyan dbu ma me long gi nang du 'char du bcug la/ de la blta zhing bsgoms la sems gzung*/ de yang gsal na gsal te 'phro gcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro gcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung bya bar nyams su blangs te gsal po byung na yun thung bar 'phro bzang mu la ngal bso/ gsal po ye mi yong na lan gcig la de'i 'phro bcad de ngal bso/ /sgom dang zhe mi 'gras pa'i gnad yin/ gsal ba'i 'phro bcad kyang rnam pa wal wal byed pa dang*/ sgom pa'i dus mi gsal la ma bsgoms pa'i dus su gsal na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas dar cig shes pa yul la yengs su bcug nas ngal bso zhing slar bsgom mo/ /ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba rnams byas nas gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'am/ mi 'jug na de ma thag bkra shis dang smon lam rnams byas la spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gsal btab ste rang dang snang ba thams cad lhar gsal ba la dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas yongs su mnyes par bya ba dang*/ snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lo yin no snyam pa'i dran 'dzin yang dang yang du gal che'o/ /de ltar yang gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar spyan dbu ma la sems brtan pa na dbu ma'i steng du rtsa ba'i spyan gnyis dang gsum ga la thun mong du thun gcig bsgom/ shangs kyi khro gnyer la thun gcig /shangs gzengs mtho ba la thun gcig /de'i steng du zhal gyi mche ba'i myu gu ljags 'dril ba dang bcas pa la thun gcig /snyan gnyis la thun gcig / snyan shal ring ba la thun gcig /rtsa zhal yongs rdzogs mgrin pa dang bcas pa la thun gcig /g.yas zhal dkar ba la thun gnyis/ de'i steng du g.yon zhal dmar ba la thun gnyis/

g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis la thun gnyis/ g.yon gyi lhag ma gnyis steng zhal gtsug tor dang bcas pa la thun gnyis/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ rtsa zhal gyi mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa la thun gnyis/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo drwa mig so gnyis pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rus pa'i rtse bran/ snyan rgyan dang bcas pa la thun gcig / mgul rgyan drwa mig bcu drug pa dang sku byin la thun gnyis/ de'i steng du phyag g.yas brgyad rgyan dang bcas shing phyag mtshan gdong nang bstan la thun gnyis/ g.yon brgyad rgyan dang bcas shing phyag mtshan gdong nang bstan la thun gnyis/ g.yon brgyad rgyan dang bcas shing phyag mtshan gdong phyir bstan/ mi mgo'i do shal/ se ral kha/ sked rgyan drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi me ri dang bcas pa la thun gnyis/ bdud bzhi mnan pa'i zhabs/ de'i rgyan yum dang bcas pa la thun gnyis/ gtso bo'i steng du gau rī bsnan pa la thun gnyis/ tsau rī sogs bdun la thun re re/ lha dgu gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la thun gcig /de'i steng du dur khrod la thun gcig /srung 'khor la thun gcig /snod bdud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gsal gdab pa la thun gcig ste de ltar na spyan dbu ma nas bzung 'di'i bar la sgom thun sum cu so gnyis/ dmigs rkang nyi shu rtsa dgu yod do/ /de tsam mi nus na spyan dbu ma la gcig /spyan gsum ga la gcig / dbu ril po la gcig /sku ril po la gcig /yum dang gdan la gcig /gtso 'khor tshang ma la gcig /gzhal yas khang la gcig /dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la thun gcig sems bzung ste/ kun dril thun brgyad do/ /de ltar bsgoms pas bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa gsal ba na phyi rol gyi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ de la goms nas rang gis mthong tshad kyi snang ba dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ de la goms nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya bskyed de 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsgom/

de la goms nas lha dang dkyil 'khor je chung du bsdus la yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam gyi dkyil 'khor gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste yungs 'bru cher ma song zhing*/ nam mkha' chung du ma song ba'i tshul du bsgom/ 'di ni bskyed rim gyi rtsal sbyong ba yin zhes chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab las bshad do/ /de ltar phyi rol gyi snang ba lhar bsgoms pas lhar 'gyur ram zhe na 'gyur te/ bsam mi khyab las/ gnyis med bcud kyis 'phig pa yi/ /rdo shing 'jim pa'i 'gyur ba rnams/ /lha yi rnam par 'gyur bar ni/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa nang bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ sgom don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa ni zin thun du 'chad/ lus dkyil de nyid nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon la lam dbang bskur nas sems 'dzin la sngar ltar gsum gyis 'jug pa'i rim pa ni phyi dkyil dang sbrags nas bsgom pa'i tshe ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal gdab/ lus dkyil rkyang pa bsgom pa'i tshe tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa mchod pas mchod la rang gi spyi bo nas bstims pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal gdab/ dbang blangs te rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs grub pa na sems 'dzin la gnas pa'i rim pa ni rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yin no zhes nga rgyal drag po bya/ de nas rten dang brten pa so sor dmigs pa gzung ba la/ rgyas par na rten lus dkyil la gcig /pho brang lnga la re re/ yan lag gi lha rnams la gcig ste bdun/ 'bring du na rten lus dkyil dang thugs kyi pho brang la gcig /pho brang bar pa gsum la re re/ gsang gnas kyi pho brang dang yan lag gi lha rnams la gcig ste lnga/ bsdu na thog mtha' gnyis de dang 'dra ba las pho brang bar pa gsum la dmigs pa gcig ste gsum du bya'o/

/gang ltar yang brten pa lha gsal 'debs pa'i tshe/ /lus chags pa'i thog ma lte ba yin pas de nas gsal 'debs/ /sems 'dzin pa'i tshe 'od gsal 'char ba'i sgo dang sems kyi gnas sa snying ga yin pas thog mar snying ga'i thugs rdo rje'i spyan dbus ma nas bzung*/ de'i zhal dang sku mdog phyag mtshan dang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la sems 'dzin/ de nas mgrin pa/ spyi bo/ lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi lha rnams la sems 'dzin no/ /de yang 'khor lo re re bzhin nam/ lha re re la sku dbyibs sogs dang*/ lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku sogs sbyar zhing phyi bskyed rim ltar gsal na gsal te 'phro gcad/ ces sogs kyi tshul du sems gzung ngo*/ /ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i mthar nang nas byung ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi lta ba skyes na de'i rgyun bskyangs la/ phyi nang sbrags pa'i bskyed rim yin na dag pa dran pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin bya/ lus dkyil rkyang pa bsgom pa yin na/ rtsa 'khor lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /sprul sku gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /'dod yon lha sku'i bde bas mchod/ /snang stong lam du longs par shog /ces lam khyer gyi smon lam byas la de'i ngang ma shor ba'i sgo nas spyod lam la 'jug go /gnyis pa lam de bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum ni/ lus rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa las skye/ phyi'i yul gyi rten du skye/ rang gi ngo bo mi rtog par skye'o/ /de la gsum/ snang phyogs kyi/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid do/ /de re re la yang ma rig pa'i snang ba las log pa'i chos can/ yid kun brtags dang bral ba'i chos nyid/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad ces bya ba gsum ting nge 'dzin gcig gi steng du brtsi ba yin te/ de yang snang ba'am stong pa sogs de dang de'i steng du sems gnas te rig pa gsal bar snang bas ma rig pa'i snang ba las log pa'i chos can/ de dang dus mnyam du tham mal gyi rnam rtog rgyun chags 'gags te rnam rtog gzhan gyis ma bslad par seng nge gnas pas yid kun brtags dang bral ba'i chos nyid/

rig pa gsal bar zin pa'i dus nyid na rtog med du gnas la/ rtog med du gnas pa'i dus nyid na rig pa gsal bar zin pas ngo bo gcig /gsal bar zin pa'i chos can dang*/ rtog med du gnas pa'i cha nas chos nyid de ldog pa tha dad do/ /rnam gzhag 'di ni sgom gyi rigs thams cad la bsgre'o/ /de dag bskyang tshul la/ mnyam gzhag gi ngo bo nyid bskyang tshul/ rjes thob kyi ngo bo nyid bskyang tshul/ de nyid ma skyes na bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum las/ snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid bskyang tshul ni/ dper na snying ga'i thugs rdo rje'i spyan dbu ma lta bu zhig la rig pa gsal bar zin te sems gnas na spyan dbu mar ma rig pa las log pa'i chos can zhes bya/ de'i tshe spyan dbu mar snang tsam las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gags nas rtog med du seng gis gnas pas yid kun brtags dang bral ba'i chos nyid ces bya/ ngo bo gcig la ldog tshul tha dad sngar bshad pa bzhin te/ des zhal dang sku la sogs pa thams cad la 'gre'o/ /ngo bo nyid 'di ni 'jug pa sel ba'i lam dang*/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs kyi ting 'dzin yin te/ 'di ni rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug dang bral ba dang snang phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin yin pas so/ /de bzhin du stong phyogs dang zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid ni dmigs pa gang bsgoms kyang dmigs pa'i yul de stong*/ de stong pa la rig pa gsal bar zin pa'i spyan dbu ma la sogs pa'i dmigs yul snang la rang bzhin med pa la rig pa gsal bar zin na stong pa sogs de dang der ma rig pa las log pa'i chos can dang*/ de'i stong par myong tsam dang*/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'char sgo de las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gags nas rtog med du seng gis gnas pas yid kun brtags dang bral ba'i chos nyid/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad sngar bshad pa bzhin te/ stong phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rol chags pa dang*/

dmigs pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa gcod pas chags pa gcod pa'i lam dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin du gzhag /zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid ni yul snang stong 'gal 'dus skyon med du 'char bas byang chub chen po'i lam dang ngo bo zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gzhag go /de ltar gsum las/ snang phyogs ni yod pa sgro 'dogs dang*/ stong phyogs ni med pa skur 'debs kyis bsdus pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin skyon can yin la/ 'on kyang dgag sgrub med par byung rgyal du bskyangs na skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren du 'gyur/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid ni/ nyams myong skyon med yin pas/ de'ang byung rgyal du bskyangs na don gyi ye shes myur du 'dren nus pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi ngo bo nyid bskyang tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag tu snang phyogs sogs de dang der goms pa'i stobs kyis rjes thob tu dngos po gang yang rung ba mthong bas rkyen byas te de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'am/ nam mkha' stong pa la sems zin pa'am/ yul snang sna tshogs su snang bzhin du bden zhen med par rtog med du gnas na yang shes pa thom gyis mi gzhag par de nyid kyi ngang ma shor bar byas la 'bad rtsol gyi sgo nas rig pa rtse gcig tu gtad de rgyun bskyang ngo*/ /gsum pa ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i thabs ni/ snang phyogs ma skyes na dben pa'i gnas su lus rnam snang gi chos bdun la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas la/ me long la sogs pa'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig yul du byas te de la mig phye btsum ran par blta zhing ma yengs bar shes pa rtsol ba glod de lhug par bzhag pas je zhig na yul de gsal bar snang bar byas la/ me long la sogs pa'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig yul du byas te de la mig phye btsum ran par blta zhing ma yengs bar shes pa rtsol ba glod de lhug par bzhag pas je zhig na yul de gsal bar snang ba la yid rtog med du seng gis gnas te de'i tshe snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid skyes pa yin no/

/stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid ma skyes na bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngar bzhin byas la mig la nyi ma dang ser bu la sogs pas mi gnod pa gnas su nam mkha' stong pa yul du byas la/ de la ma yengs par blta zhing shes pa rtsol ba glod de lhug par bzhag pas nam mkha' stong pa la rig pa gsal bar zin zhing yid rtog med du gnas/ de'i tshe stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid skyes pa yin no/ /zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid ma skyes na bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngar bzhin byas la nyin par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang mtshan mo chu nang gi zla ba la mig phye btsum ran par blta zhing shes pa rtsol ba glod de lhug par bzhag pas snang la rang bzhin med pa la rig pa gsal bar zin zhing yid rtog med du seng gis gnas na zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid skyes pa yin no/ /bskyed rim bsgoms kyang mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma skyes na tshogs lam chig rkyang du shor ba bya ba yin/ /bskyed rim la brten nas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes na tshogs drod 'byor pa yin pas rnal 'byor pa'i lam sna 'di nas zin par dpal sa skya pa chen pos bshad ces gsungs so/ / gsum pa grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum goms pa la brten nas 'das lam sa dang po nas drug pa man la bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim mthar phyin te/ 'khor ba snod bcud du snang ba 'di thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du shar bas lha dang gzhal yas khang las logs na snod bcud med cing 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang dbyer med du rtogs pas snang sems ro gcig tu 'dres shing rtsig pa dang ri sogs la thogs pa med/ stong gsum yungs 'brur chud pa la che chung med pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan te/ de tsam na bskyed rim bsgom mi dgos par snang ba thams cad lhar 'char/

sgra thams cad sngags su 'char lus kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur/ sprul sku'i zhing khams la dbang thob/ btsun mos pang nas 'khyud de zag med kyi bde ba rgyun mi chad pa la longs spyod pa yin no// bzhi pa 'da' ka ma gang du 'pho ba ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma snyogs na 'chi khar snyogs pa'i thabs su gang zag 'bring gis 'da' ka ma nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang 'chi mi 'chi legs par brtags la/ nges par 'chi bar rtogs pa na 'da' ka ma bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan du na lha bsad pa'i nyes par 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ dus thob na ni 'pho bya yi/ /dus min lha ni gsod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'chi ba'i dus nges nas 'pho ba sbyang dgos pas/ de'i tshul la 'chi ltas brtag pa/ de bslu ba'i thabs/ ma bslus na 'pho ba gsum gyi dang po la/ phyi'i 'chi ltas/ nang gi 'chi ltas/ snang tshul la brtag pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ me tog dmar po 'thu ba/ thang dmar po la 'gro ba/ rgyus med pa'i rgyal khams su 'gro ba dang*/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyad pa dang*/ de lta bus bdag gi lto ba phral nas nang khrol bton pa dang*/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba la sogs pa rmi ba dang*/ dngos su rang gi lus ngag gi spyod pa la skyo ba dang*/ gnas dang grogs la skyo ba/ spyod pa dang gshis 'gyur te spro ring ba thung du song ba dang*/ thung ba ring du song ba dang*/ rtsing ba ser sna cher song ba dang*/ ser sna can rtsing bar song ba dang*/ bsam gtan 'dor ba ste 'di rnams ma nges pa'i 'chi ltas yin no/ /nang gi 'chi ltas ni/ spyir sna g.yon nas rlung grangs mang du rgyu na dge zhing tshe ring la/ g.yas nas mang du rgyu na mi dge zhing tshe thung ngo*/ /gang ltar yang tho rangs kyi thun nas nyi ma shar ba yan chad du phal cher la tshes gcig dang gnyis dang gsum la g.yon nas rgyu/

bzhi dang lnga dang drug la g.yas nas rgyu/ de ltar zhag gsum gsum spel ba'i gnam gang gi bar go rim bzhin du rgyu'o/ /sna bug gang rung zhig nas zhag kha yar btud nas rgyu ba la ni nyes pa cher med cing go log nas rgyu ba la ni nyes pa yod do/ /de'ang zhag drug go log na 'thab rtsod dang yid la sdug bsngal drag po 'byung bar 'gyur/ zla ba phyed go log na nad drag po 'byung bar 'gyur/ zla ba gcig go log na gnyen 'brel dag rgud par 'gyur/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis la log nas rgyun zla ba drug na nges par 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /snang tshul la brtag pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' tshe gzugs brtags te/ mgo dang yan lag ma tshang ba dang*/ gzhan yang nam mkha'i me tog yal ba dang*/ mig gi 'od zer nyams pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i sgra yal ba dang*/ gnam sa'i 'brel thag chad pa zhes bya ba sna'i thad kar lag pa gtad pas chad la khad pa zhig kun la 'ongs kyang krigs kyis chad na zla ba drug na 'chi ba yin/ de la sogs pa 'chi ltas te ma nges pa'o/ / gnyis pa 'chi bslu la/ phyi'i 'chi bslu ni/ tshe sgrub kyi cho ga dang*/ dad pa chen pos bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ tshogs bsag dang*/ sāts+tsha dang gtor ma dang srog chags kyi tshe skyabs pa la sogs pa 'bad rtsol drag pos bya'o/ /nang gi 'chi bslu la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngon du 'gro bas tho rangs srog rtsol gyi rlung stong tsam re bzla ba'am/ yang na rlung bum pa can bsgoms pas nges par bzlog par 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ yang na bum pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ rtag tu 'chi bdag las rgyal bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thun mong ma yin pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gdams ngag nam mkha' zas su za ba ni nam langs nas lag pa'i ri mo mthong ba tsam na gnam sngo sang nge ba mthong ba'i sar bsdad la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar byas te nam mkha' la kha gtad de/

khams gsum gyi nam mkha' thams cad 'od sngon po'i tshul du rang gi kha na mar sib sib song bas bsam zhing rlung kha nas sgra med du dgang lus thams cad khrig khengs pa na mchil ma gcig mid de ol kos o mdud mnan la khog pa'i nang thams cad rgyan nam mkha' sngo bsang nge bas khengs par bsam zhing rlung thub tshad gzung ngo*/ /de ltar yang yang byas pas sgregs pa gcig byung na 'chi ba bslus pa yin te/ 'di kho na bzhin bsgom na 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob ces gsungs te/ de'ang*/ sbyor bas nam mkha' zas su za/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'chi med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ma bslus na gang du 'pho ba la snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma/ 'od kyi gong bu'i 'da' ka ma/ sgras 'pho ba'i 'da' ka ma'o/ /dang po ni/ da lta nyid nas spyod lam thams cad du snang ba yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor yin snyam pa'i dran 'dzin drag po yang dang yang du gtang zhing*/ khyad par gnyid du 'gro khar de lta bu'i dran pa mi brjed par byas la rmi lam gyi snang ba yang yi dam gyi lhar 'char bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang ste nyal bas goms na de ltar 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon 'gro sbyang ba'o/ /de nas nam zhig nges pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe bla ma spyan drangs la bdog pa thams cad btang ste dbang blang*/ yang na rang gis bdag 'jug byas te dbang blang*/ rdo rje spun grogs rnams spyan drangs la tshogs kyis 'khor lo bya/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bshags/ yo byad thams cad dge ba'i phyogs su gtad/ zang zing gi dngos po la chags zhen med par byas la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis lha dang bla ma tha mi dad pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ci 'byor phul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ mos gus drag pos gsol ba dung dung ba gdab/ de nas 'chi ba la thug ste snang ba za zi sna tshogs nam byung ba'i tshe bdag nyid lhar bsgoms pa de dor nas mdun gyi snang ba de lhar dran par byas nas lha'i snang ba de dang bdag gi shes pa ro gcig par gyur te bar do'i snang ba mi 'char bar grub mtha' snyogs pa'am rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/

/'od kyi gong bu'i 'da' ka ma ni/ lha dang bla ma tha mi dad pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ lus tsog pur bya/ lag pa gnyis ltag pa nas skyor/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i nang du 'od kyi gong bu mthe bong tsam zhig bsgom/ de las 'od kyi gong bu re mched pas dang por dmyal bar skye ba'i sgo bshang ba'i lam dgag /de nas dud 'gro'i sgo gci ba'i lam/ 'dod khams kyi lha'i sgo lte ba/ yi dwags kyi sgo kha/ gnod sbyin gyi sgo sna bug gnyis/ mi'i rgyal po dang phal pa'i sgo mig g.yas g.yon/ mi'am ci'i sgo rna ba gnyis/ gzugs khams kyi lha'i sgo mdzod spu/ gzugs med kyi lha'i sgo spyi gtsug rnams dgag par bya ste/ gdan bzhi las/ sgo rnams kyi ni bye brag las/ /'khor ba'i bye brag 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas lte ba'i nang du rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla ba phyed pa lta bu/ de'i steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sems kyi rten hūm̐ mthing nag rnams che chung ci rigs par bsams la/ stobs kyi hūm̐ drag ring bar drangs/ rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa rim gyis yar byon/ de bzhin du nyi shu tham pa'i bar du byas pas mgrin par byon/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la tshangs pa'i sgo bsal te rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ gsum ga lhag pa'i lha'i thugs kar 'phangs na grub mtha' snyogs pa'am rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa sgras 'pho ba'i 'da' ka ma ni/ sngon 'gro lha dang bla ma spyan drangs pa sogs dang*/ lus tsog pu sogs sngar dang 'dra bar byas la/ sgo rnams dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma bzhin yi ges dgag /rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ rnams ni lte bar bsams la hig ces pas mgrin pa'i bar du drangs/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pas tshangs pa'i sgo nas snga ma bzhin 'phangs na grub mtha' snyoms pa'am rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa bar do yi dam gyi lha dang bdag sems ro gcig pa ni/

gal te 'da' ka ma mi thebs pa 'dra na gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ de'i tshul la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni gnas skabs thams cad du 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang la yang ma chags pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang*/ skyo shas drag pos kun nas bslangs te chags sdang rmongs gsum skye ba'i yul thams cad lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor shes pa'i dag snang zab mo'i dran 'dun dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon sku rdo rje sprul skur dran pa/ des bstan pa rang lus yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du dran pa/ lha las dras pa'i rdo rje'i ming dran pa ste gsum 'brel ba can du dus kyi nges pa gcig la dran par bya zhing*/ khyad par du kha zas za ba'i dus dang*/ 'jigs shing nyam nga ba'i dus dang*/ gnyid du 'gro kha dang*/ gnyid zad mtshams rnams su de gsum dran pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang bas/ rmi lam du 'jigs skrag la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe yang*/ de gsum gyi dran 'dun rang babs su 'byung zhing*/ des rkyen byas na rmi lam gyi 'khrul snang yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhar 'char ba zhig ma byung gi bar du 'bad par bya ste/ goms pa'i stobs kyis rmi lam du de ltar byung na bar dor nyams len ji lta ba bzhin thog tu khel bas bar do dngos grub len pa'i dus zhes bshad pa yin no/ /dngos gzhi ni/ bar dor yid lus phra ba zhig blangs pa'i tshe/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang*/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste/ rkyen bdun shar ba na de dang rjes su mthun par bar do'i longs spyod bsnam bya dri lnga/ 'od kyi lam kha dog 'char ba/ de dag gis rkyen byas te goms pa'i dbang gis dang por phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod par byed pa'i bla ma dran pa dang*/ des bstan pa'i bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar dran pa 'byung la/ de ma thag bsnam bya yang lhag pa'i lhar shar te/

rten 'brel des gsang mtshan nas lung ston pa 'byung zhing snang ba dang bdag gi sems ro gcig par gyur nas bar do nyid du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /de tsam na bdud kyi lung bstan par srid pas da lta nyid nas dbang bzhi'i brda la goms pa dang gsang mtshan gsang ba shin tu gces so/ /drug pa 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub ni 'bras bu'i skabs nyid 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba la/ lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'da' ka ma 'od gsal ba/ zhar byung bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la rtog med/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste drug gi dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi khrid kyi rim pa gnyis/ dang po la/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsag sbyang gi rnal 'byor dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir yang grub na bla ma la dbang blang bar gsungs pas/ de'i dod da lta yum gyi byin rlabs re mdzad nas gsang dbang gi khrid 'dzugs par mdzad/ de'i tshe rlung ltas brtags te dpon slob gnyis ka'i rlung g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dus su man ngag bstan na nyams myur du skye yang mi brtan zhing bar chad 'byung ste/ de yang rtsol pa'am/ gzung ba'am/ duḥkha skyed pa'am 'phrog pa'am nyi ma'i rlung yin pas de'i dus su mi bstan/ gnyis ka'i g.yon nas rgyu na nyams skye ba bul yang skyes pa brtan zhing bar chad chung ste/ de yang srog gam 'dzin pa'am bde ba skyed pa'am sdud par byed pa'am zla ba'i rlung zhes bya ba yin pas de'i dus su bstan no/ /gnyis ka nas rgyu ba ni ma ning gi rlung zhes bya ba 'pho ba'i mtshams yin pas/ de'i tshe'ang ting nge 'dzin gsha' ma mi skye bas mi bstan no/ /yun ring du g.yas su rgyu na g.yon du 'pho bar bsgoms pas 'pho ba'ang srid/

des 'pho ru ma btub na nu ma bcud la bor ba zhes bya ba sna bug g.yon pa bkag ste g.yas pa nas rlung drag tu rngubs la lag pa'i gru mos nu ma dang lag mthil gyis 'gram pa g.yas drag tu mnyes la mthar sna bug g.yas pa bkag ste g.yon nas 'bud/ de lta bu lan kha yar byas pas 'pho'o/ /de ltar na dpon slob gnyis ka'i g.yon nas rgyu ba'i dus su bstan na bkra shis shing bar chad chung ba yin no/ /de nas bsag sbyang gnyis sngar bstan pa bzhin las maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor gyi mthar bla ma rang la bstims te/ snying ga'i dbus su bzhugs pa de la nang rdo rje'i lus kyi maṇ+ḍal dbul te/ de yang don yid la dran bzhin pas/ pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rak+ta'i rlan gyis kun sa byugs/ /sgal tshigs ri rgyal lhun po la/ /yan lag bzhi yi gling bzhis brgyan/ /ro rkyang dkar dmar byang chub sems/ /nyi zla gser dngul la sogs pa/ /lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /don snod bde cha rin chen bdun/ / haṃ las rgyun babs 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /sku gsum lhun grub ma rmos lo/ /rtsa phran sna tshogs dpag bsam shing*/ /rang lus yon tan mtha' yas kyi/ /zas gos 'bru sogs dpag med rnams/ /snying dbus thig ler brtan bzhugs pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas khyed la 'bul/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha sogs gong bzhin brjod la ci nus dbul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa gnyis ka'i grangs bzung la/ 'di tsam song zhes bla ma la grangs dbul/ de'i tshe kha 'cham na bar chad che zhing ting nge 'dzin ngan la/ kha yar na bar chad chung zhing ting nge 'dzin bzang po skye'o/ /gnyis pa thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag la/ sbyang ba gsum/ gnad la dbab pa gsum/ sgom pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rdzogs rim zab mo kun gyi sngon 'gro ni/ /sbyang ba rnam gsum de nas rlung la bslab/ /ces gsungasate/

de la lus sbyang ba/ ngag sbyang ba/ yid sbyang ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su lus thams cad dri chus bkrus la bsku mnye bya/ nyi ma la cung zad 'dug /rdul mi thon tsam du ran par gcag / phyag dang bskor ba bya/ de nas/ mgo bo mjing pa bsgyur bya zhing*/ /lag pa gnyis ni so sor g.yab/ /rkang pa gnyis ni drag tu sprug /yan lag lnga yi sbyang ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi lus sbyang bsdus pa tsam mam/ shes shing nus na lus sbyang rgyas pa nyi shu pa dang*/ gnyis ka lag len bzhin lus dub dub byas la/ lus sems khong slod de/ gsal ba rang so gzung*/ lhug pa rang so bzung ste/ de yang re zhig 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ dka' las med cing na tsha med la lus bde zhing yang ba yin no/ kha cig la skabs der ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba'ang srid do/ /gang ltar yang lus sbyang yun ring du byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du skye zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad mi 'byung ba yin no/ /ngag sbyang ba ni/ mdo zlos pa dang sngags bzla ba la sogs pa'i thun yod na shub bu'i sgo nas ma chag tsam bya/ gzhan tha ma pa'i gtam smra ba la sogs pa'i ngag gi las thams cad spang ngo*/ /sems sbyang ba ni/ mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyong yod na thun ma chag tsam bya/ gzhan dge mi dge'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs la yid skyo sang nge bzhag ste yid skyo ba'i gnas su bsam gtan 'khor/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnad la dbab pa gsum gyi dang po lus gnad la dbab pa ni/ skyil krung dang tsog pu gang bde rgyab rten med par tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mgo cung zad sgug /mig sna rtser phob/ lce rkan la sbyar/ so dang mchu mnyam par sbyar te khang pa rtsig pa'i 'gram dang 'dra'o/ /de nas sna sgo nas rlung phyir lan gsum drag tu 'bud/ de ni ngag gnad la dbab pa ste khang pa'i mi gtsang ba phyags dar byed pa dang 'dra'o/ / de nas sems lhod glod nas 'jog pa ni sems gnad la dbab pa ste rta bang rgyug khar dbugs 'dod pa dang 'dra'o/

/sgom pa gsum gyi dang po sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam bsgom snyam pa ni byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la mos gus drag po bya zhing gang drin ma la sogs pas bstod/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig /gsung gi rdo rje longs sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /rab byung ston mdzad nang gi bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngag la gsang dbang stsol/ /gtum mo'i lam bzang sgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung rnam bzhi'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na/ /'od gsal dbyings su 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na/ /gsal la rtog med bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs 'grub ste/ /longs sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sbyar/ gsum pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu po de ni bsam gtan thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la/ dmigs pa'i lugs mang na'ang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di ni khams 'dus pa dang po gtum mo rlung drod rtags kyi lam khrid pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed de/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu bla mas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ man ngag nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'dus la/ de'ang man ngag dgu brgya phrag gcig tu 'du zhing*/ de'ang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar 'du la/ de'ang bcur 'du zhing*/ de'ang ldang ba dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ thams cad sdom pa dang bzhir 'du ba yin no/ /de'ang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'dis man ngag bzhi po thams cad lam du byed pa la srog rtsol lam/

rdo rje'i bzlas pa phyir gtang ba'i man ngag gsum ni/ rtsol ba bkag nas srog nas gtang ba/ shugs bskyed de gnyis ka nas gtang ba/ kha nas sgra bcas su gtang ba'o/ /nang du dgang ba'i man ngag gnyis ni/ rtsol ba bkag nas srog nas dgang ba dang*/ kha nas sgra med du dgang ba'o/ /gnas pa lam du byed pa kha sbyar zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i nyams su blang ba re re la'ang bzhi bzhi ste/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad/ yon tan gang skye ba/ skyon gang sel ba'o/ /de la dang po srog rtsol nyams su blang na/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song bar byas nas/ khor gcig sna g.yas bkag la g.yon du rgyu ru gzhug /de nas gong ltar bde bar rgyur gzhug ste/ thog mar rtsol ba nas mgo 'dzin/ rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su phyir rgyus/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe nang du rgyus/ cung zad gnas pa'i tshe gnas zhes dran par bya zhing bslab/ de la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas/ rtsol ba la rngan dgas rim gyis byin te/ phyir ring du rgyus/ nang du thung du rgyus/ nang du gnas zhes dran par bya/ de la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas srog nas mgo bzung ste/ nang du rgyus/ gnas/ phyir rgyus snyam du dran par bya/ 'di rdo rje'i bzlas par byed na nang du rgyus pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir 'gro ba hūm̐ zhes dran par byas kyang btub bo/ /de la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas/ srog la rngan dgas rim gyis byin te/ nang du ring du rgyus/ nang du gnas/ phyir thung ngu rgyus/ zhes dran par byas te/ 'dis nang du yun ring du gnas shing ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye'o/ /srog rtsol mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ rgyu ba gsal ba zhes bya ba 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i gnas dang*/ kha dog dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ ring thung gi tshad kyang mig gis mthong ba yin no/ /rnam pa nges pa zhes bya ba sna g.yas g.yon spo ba dang*/ dbang po gzhan gyi sgo nas gtang ba dang*/

bzlog par nus pa yin no/ /bsgoms pa'i yon tan ni/ phrin las bzhi 'grub pa ste/ de'ang sa rlung rgyu ba gsal ba'i dus su/ sngags tsam mam/ bsam pa'i smon lam btab pa tsam gyis rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ de bzhin du chu rlung gis zhi ba/ me rlung gis dbang*/ rlung gi rlung gis mngon spyod kyi las rnams thogs pa med par 'grub pa yin no/ /yang na pha rol gyi srog gi rlung gi lam nas bcug nas pha rol gyi nang du kun tu bltas na gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyang 'byung ngo*/ /skyon gang sel na g.yang sa dang*/ rdib gri dang thog la sogs pa glo bur gyis 'chi ba'i rkyen gang gis kyang bar chad mi nus te/ tshe la cung zad dbang ba yin no/ /da ni gnyis pa rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas gtang ba'i man ngag ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag tshang bar byas nas/ sems sna rtse'i sna bug g.yon du gtad la/ sna g.yas pa bkag la rlung nang du rngub ste/ g.yon nas phar bus la gtang ngo*/ /gtang ba'i yan lag la rlung nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad che/ 'di ni skyon can phyir bton pa yin pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin shugs la skye'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ phyir gtong rgyu med par rlung zad nas ci tsam 'dod pa phyir bzhag nas/ nang du 'ong du mi gzhug par khegs pa yin no/ / yon tan lus bde bas khengs pa dang*/ mi rtog pa myur du skye'o/ /skyon ni ro stod gzer ba dang*/ snying mi bde ba sel lo/ /'di lam mi sgom pa'i tshe'ang nyam nga'i gnas su 'gro ba'am chu la brgal ba'i tshe rtsol pa bkag ste srog nas gtang ba khor bdun bdun tsam byas na bar chad thams cad sel lo/ /gsum pa shugs bskyed de gnyis ka nas gtang ba ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag tshang bar byas la/ rang gi shes pa mdzod spur gtad de/ rlung gi gnad gnyis ka nas shugs bskyed la bus la gtang*/ phyir thub tshad mnan/ gtang ba la rlung nang 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad du che/

de la zhag gsum tsam bsgom/ de nas rang gi mdun khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' stong pa la yid gtad/ de nas 'dom gang tsam la/ de nas mdung gang tsam la/ de nas rgya che ba'i lung pa gcig tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ de nas sa skor gcig tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ mthar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nam mkha' thams cad la/ yang na shes pa ci yang mi rtog pa la gtad la bsgom/ rlung gi gnad snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i tshad snga ma dang 'dra/ yon tan gsal ba'i nyams su myong ba mthar thug pa skye/ skyon mgo na ba dang mig khrag tu song ba la sogs pa thams cad sel bar nus so/ /bzhi pa kha nas sgra bcas su gtang ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas la/ rang gi 'dom gang khor yug gi nam mkha' la sems gtad pa'o/ /si'i sgra la sems gtad la/ rlung so bar nas si'i sgra dang bcas pas bus la gtang*/ phyir thub tshad mnan/ gtang ba la nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa gnad du che/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /yon tan lus ldang ba yang ba dang*/ zo mdog bde ba 'byung ngo*/ /skyon ni khrag ro dang rims glo bur ba la sogs pa tshad nad mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ /lnga pa rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas dgang ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag tshang bar byas la/ lte bar sgo nga'i skogs pa 'dra ba phyi dkar la nang ser ba gcig gi nang na mar rlung sems sib sib 'gro bar bsam zhing*/ sna g.yas bkag la g.yon nas rdzogs par rngubs la/ rlung gi rta mchil ma mid la mnan/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni ci tsam 'dod tshad thub cing na tsha med pa yin no/ /yon tan drod dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ste/ slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi nyams rnams kyang 'di las skyes pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skyon ni grang ba dang skran dang ma zhu ba'i nad rnams sel lo/ /drug pa kha nas sgra med du dgang ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag tshang bar byas la/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum sngon po'i nang na mar rlung thams cad sib sib 'gro bar bsam zhing*/

rlung kha nas sgra med du bkang la mchil ma mid la thub tshad du mnan/ 'di la sgra bag tsam byung na drod nyams nas 'gro bas sgra med du mnan no/ /mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ nyin mtshan med par mnan yang na tsha med par thub pa yin no/ /yon tan ni drod dang bsdongs bde gsal skye'o/ / skyon ni dmu chu la sogs pa lto ba'i nad sel/ khyad par du gang na sar mnan la 'bigs pa lta bur byas na 'byung ba lus 'khrugs thams cad sel lo/ /dgang ba'i yan lag gnyis po 'di la thun mong gi dmigs pa gzhan yang lte bar 'od dkar po gcig gi nang na a dmar po mtshal gyi shad lta bu zhig la rlung sems sib sib 'gro bar dmigs pa'am/ 'od dkar po med par dmar po nyid la sib sib song bas me sor gnyis sam bzhi'i bar la dmigs pa'am/ lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'am ser po dmigs la/ de sa gzhi ltar rgya skyed rgya mtsho ltar gting zab/ nam mkha' ltar dpangs gtod pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /gtang ba gsum ka'i gnad la nang du rim gyis 'ong du gzhug pa dang dgang ba gnyis ka dang kha sbyar dang gsum ka la phyir gtong ba'i tshe rim gyis gtang ba gnad du che'o/ /phyir gtang ba la nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa dang*/ nang du dgang ba la phyir mi gtong ba gnad du che/ nang du dgang ba'i rlung gi sbyor ba gcig la yang yang mi rngub pa gnad du che'o/ /lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ji ltar bde ba yin kyang gtang ba gsum la tsog pu dang*/ dgang ba gnyis la skyil krung ngo*/ /da ni bdun pa kha sbyor zhes bya ba lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu yin pas/ de'i dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar bya/ bye brag tu lus skyil krung du gnad la dbab/ lte bar a shad lta bu gcig la rlung thams cad bstim zhing bsgom mo/ /de'ang bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ dang po 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ de nas steng rlung rdzogs pa dang mchil ma mid la mnan/

de nas 'og rlung drag tu bskum/ de lta bu de la steng 'og gi rlung mi 'chor bar thub na gnad ma 'khrul ba yin/ steng rlung mnan pas 'og rlung mi thems shing 'og 'then pas steng ma non na gnad 'khrul pa yin/ 'og rlung bskums pas steng rlung rang 'gags su 'gro /steng rlung mnan pas 'og rlung rang shugs kyis 'thon par 'gro zhing*/ rlung phyir btang yang 'gror ma 'dod na yon tan rin po che skye ba'i mchog yin no/ /de'ang rlung non pa'i tshad ni/ rtsol ba yang rab rgyun mi chad/ /rtsol ba rab la drug cu bzhi/ /rtsol ba 'bring la sum cu gnyis/ /rtsol ba tha ma nges pa med ces bya ste/ thun la sbyar na yang rab kyis kha sbyar rgyun mi 'chad pa 'ong*/ rab kyis thun gcig la kha sbyar drug cu rtsa bzhi re 'ong*/ /'bring gis thun re la sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tha mas nges pa med par bsgom zhes gsungs te 'di ni gtso bor mi mdzad/ kha sbyar re re'i tshad la sbyar na/ pus mo la bskor ba re dang*/ se gol gtogs pa yang rab kyis rgyun mi chad par 'ong*/ rab kyis drug cu rtsa bzhi/ 'bring sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tha ma nges pa med par 'byung ba yin no/ /de'ang nyi ma re re'am thun re re la 'phel bcug na tha ma yang rab tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar skyil krung la ji ltar 'dod pa thub nas spyod lam gyi sgo nas sbyang bar bya ste/ tsog pur sbyang*/ de la 'byongs nas langs la sbyang*/ de nas 'gro yin sbyang*/ de nas las byed pa la sogs pa bya ba thams cad kyi sgo nas kyang sbyang bar bya'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i tshadani/ nyin zhag du mar kha sbyar thub cing lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bcas pa tsam gyis kyang ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ba yin no/ /skyon ni 'byung ba lus 'khrugs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi skyon sel lo/ /yon tan ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /kha sbyor gyi rnal 'byor 'di la 'og rlung bskum mi shes pa sgal tshigs na sar dbyug pa btsugs pa lta bu'i mi bde ba byung na/

skyil krung bcas la lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la/ stan la btsugs te lus bar snang la bteg la smad stan gyi steng du brdab par bya'o/ / de lta bu 'khor kha cig gis sel bar 'gyur la/ gegs gzhan sel ba ni gegs sel rgyas pa nyid kyi steng du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i dmigs pa ni/ spyir rgyud sde rnams las tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs na'ang de thams cad kyi nyams su blang ba'i man ngag gi gnad mdor bsdu na dgur 'du ste/ 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga/ brten pa gsum/ man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba ste dgu'o/ /'di'i dang po la mar me gso ba/ tshangs pa'i thog /rtsa ba'i rnal 'byor/ srubs shing gi 'khor lo/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang lnga gsungs pa'i dang po nyams su blang tshul ni/ 'di man chad thams cad la bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu dang*/ rlung srog rtsol kha yar bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas bsam gtan gyi lam bsal te/ de nas dngos gzhi sgom pa la 'jug la/ de yang dang po 'di la lus gnad tsog pu la/ dmigs pa'i gnad lte 'og sor bzhi na k+ṣa yig dmar nag mgo bo thur la blta ba me'i rang bzhin gzhi la gnas pa dang*/ lte bar aṃ kha dog dmar skya mgo bo gyen du blta ba gsal gdab/ de nas 'og sgo rlung 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum gyi tha ma la rlung cung zad 'then pas sum mdo'i me kha dog dmar la reg bya tsha ba'i rnam par 'bar bas lte 'og gi k+ṣa yig cher 'bar te/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas aṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun cha phra mo zhig babs pas mar me'i sdong po la 'bru mar blugs pa ltar k+ṣa'i me gsos par bsams la steng rlung rim gyis bcug ste/ rlung gi rta mchil ma sgra med du mid/ ol kos ol mdud mnan la 'og rlung cung zad bskum ste rlung kha sbyar nas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad/ rlung mi thub na dal bus gtang*/

de'i lam sbyang ba ni/ dmigs pa de nyid mnyam gzhag tu 'bad nas bsgom pa ste ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu yin no/ /lta ba bskyang ba ni/ thun zhabs su sems rtsol ba glod la mig thad kar had de blta bar bya ste mi rtog pa mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams skye'o/ / drod byung rgyal du bskyang ba ni/ lam bsgoms pa la brten nyams mtho dman bde sdug ci skyes kyang rlung sems kyi rten 'brel du shes pa'i sgo nas re dogs dang dgag sgrub med par lam du bsrel lo/ /thun grangs dang thun tshad med pa ni/ thun gsum dang bzhi la sogs pa nges pa med par bsgom pa dang*/ thun re la dmigs pa 'di grangs 'di tsam bsgom zhes pa lta bu'i tshad gzung med pa'o/ / yid 'jug yul brtag pa ni/ spro na bsgom la mi spro na mi sgom pa ste/ spro bzhin du ma bsgoms na lam gong 'phel du mi 'gyur/ mi spro bzhin du bsgoms na rta 'grog can ltar sgom dang sems 'gras te phyis bsgom du mi btub pa'o/ / khams tshod gzung ba ni/ khams bzang bzhin du ma bsgoms na ting nge 'dzin gong 'phel du mi 'byung*/ khams ngan bzhin du bsgoms na 'byung ba lus 'khrugs su 'gyur bas khams bso zhing tshod zin par bsgom mo/ /zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bskul ba ni/ kha zas yang la bcud che ba za/ spyod lam dal zhing bag yang bsten/ rlung dang nyi ma dang me la mi bsdad/ rdul 'ong du mi gzhug /lus gnad skyil krung dang tsog pu gang bde la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa tshangs pa'i thog ni/ gzhung bshad dag las/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'/ /byang sems haṃ gi 'ben la brdeg /myur du ye shes 'char bar 'gyur/ / zhes 'byung bas/ de'i lam nyams len ni/ lus skyil krung bya/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la dgab/ lte bar rlung gi gzhu sngon po dang*/ sum mdor me'i mda' dmar po mda' ltaung sbyar ba chang bzung dang mde'u bshang sgor 'dzom pa zhig bsgom/

lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du rtsa dbu ma zangs dung lta bu 'phel kha thur du bstan pa zhig dang*/ de'i yas snar spyi bo'i haṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba zhig rnams gsal btab la/ 'og rlung drag shul du bskum pa dang bstun nas lto ba tshigs pa la drag tu gcer/ mig steng du log gis bgrad pas steng rlung rang 'gags su 'gro /'og rlung gi nus pas mda' gzhu rgyab ngos nas khyu ru ru 'gyur te/ mde'u rtse lte bar sleb par bsam/ de nas ro stod gyen du 'then byas pas mda' gzhu khengs te mde'u rtse dbu ma'i mas snar chud par bsams/ lus kyi stod ldig gis bsgyur bas mda' ltong bral te/ me'i mda' de dbu ma'i nang na yang thal gyis song ba spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas haṃ las bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun lta skya nar nar ba'am/ mu tig gi rdog ma ltar dkar krig krig pa rgyun ma chad pa byung bas me de thur du bdas de lte bar sleb par bsams la lus sems khong glod de/ 'bar 'dzag la shes pa gtad do/ /de lta bu thun re'i nang du lan re las mi sgom pa 'di'i sgos kyi dmigs bsal te/ lan gcig tsam gyis sems gnas pas/ /'dzag pa 'ba' zhig bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus kyi gnad tsog pu/ sems kyi gnad rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe gsang gnas kyi g.yas ngos nas lte ba/ lte ba nas snying ga /snying ga nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i bar du g.yas ro ma nyi ma me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po/ sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam gsal gdab/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe spyi bo'i g.yon ngos nas mgrin pa/ mgrin pa nas snying ga /snying ga nas lte ba/ lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar du g.yon rkyang ma zla ba chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po/ sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam gsal gdab/ rlung gnas pa'i tshe de gnyis kyi bar dbu ma pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ste rta rnga brgyar bshags pa tsam/

chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ste ya yo med pa/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar zhing snum pa/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal te dwangs shing 'od gsal ba/ zhes chos bzhi ldan du gsal btab ste/ rlung 'gro 'ong gnas gsum dang bstun nas rtsa gsum po gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar du gshibs nas gnas pa la sems yang dang yang du gtad cing sbyangs pas/ yid gar chags nges par med de gang la chags par gzhag /rjes lta ba bskyang ba sogs sngar bzhin no/ /srubs shing gi 'khor lo ni/ lus kyi gnad tsog pu/ sems kyi gnad lus kyi dbus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar skya smyug ma 'bring po tsam/ g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang gnyis gong bzhin rtsa gsum 'dzom pa'i mas snar ngo bo me la rnam pa khrag gi thig le sran ma tsam zhig rnams gsal gdab/ rlung gi gnad kha sbyor bzung bas g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis 'dar phril ba dang bcas pas/ dbu ma la gcer te gsor bsgril ba bzhin hril hril byas pas/ dbu ma'i mas snes khrag gi thig le de har har btang bar bsam/ rjes lta ba bskyang ba sogs 'dra'o/ /lnga pa thig le'i rnal 'byor la/ snying ga'i nyi zla kha sbyor/ lte ba'i dpa' bo 'ba' zhig /gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le/ mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu tshang bar byas la lus skyil krung bya/ snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du 'og tu zla ba steng du nyi ma de gnyis sran ma bkas pa tsam gyi bar du thig le kha dog dkar dmar/ rnam pa gsal ba/ ngo bo bde stong chos sum ldan bsam/ de nas de la yid cung zad cig gtad pas/ thig le las sing zer ba'i sgra la brten nas steng gi nyi ma la bu ga rta rnga shong ba tsam zhig byung bar bsam/ de nas rlung kha nas sgra med du bkang bas bu ga nas thig le la sib sib thim/ de nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug pa skye'o/

/gzhan yang mngon shes myur du 'char/ gnyis pa ni sngon 'gro spyi dang mthun/ lus skyil krung du bcas la/ lte bar thig le kha dog dkar dmar/ rnam pa gsal ba/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa chos sum ldan zhig bsams la/ steng rlung rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas sam/ kha nas sgra med du bkang ste mnan la thig le la bstim/ ting nge 'dzin mi rtog pa myur du skye'o/ /gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ lus tsog pu/ rdo rje'i bum par thig le pad+ma rwa ga lta bu dmar ba rnam pa bde gsal ngo bo zung 'jug chos sum ldan du bsams la/ 'og rlung cher bskums la bstim/ glod rtsa na dal bus glod/ drag shul du glod na thig le nyams te 'gro gsungs/ de ltar bsgoms pas nor bu 'gas pa snyam byed pa'i bde ba 'byung*/ thig le 'dzag pa'am/ chags pa skyes na bgrad pa'i mtha' 'am mdzod spur shes pa gtad/ des zhi'o/ /de tsam na lte bar 'gyur ba byas pas lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa skye'o/ /rlung 'og rlung bya/ ting nge 'dzin bde ba myur du skye'o/ / mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ lus gnad skyil krung*/ mdzod spur ham̐ 'khyog po mgo thur la lta ba bsam/ de nas rtsol ba'i rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su lce chung gi rgyab nas song nas haṃ la phog pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lce chung gi gsum gyi bar du babs/ de las babs pas snying ga'i hūm̐ tshim par bsam/ de la shes pa gtad/ yang nang du 'jug pa na'ang babs/ de la shes pa gtad/ mu tig gi rdog ma'am 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu 'dzag pa gnyis sems nyams dang sbyar/ skabs su lce rtsa 'gul ba tsam bya/ og mas ol mdud mnan/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar te bsgom/ rlung srog rtsol dang bstun/ yon tan skra dkar dang gnyer ma spang zhing khams brtas par byed do/ /rjes lta ba bskyang ba sogs 'dra/ gnyis pa 'khor lo la brten pa la 'khor lo gcig la brten pa rno/

gnyis la brten pa myur/ bzhi la brten pa brtan zhes bya ba gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ lus kyi gnad tsog pu/ sems kyi gnad bshang sgor las kyi rlung gzhu bdungs pa lta bu dang*/ sum mdor ye shes kyi me gru gsum rang bzhin gyis gnas pa gsal gdab/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang du nang ltar bshad pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma zhes bya ba aṃ shin tu cha phra ba/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs gsal sde tshan brgyad kyi thog ma/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad kha dog dmar po g.yas skor/ phyi skor 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yi ge dgod pa dang bral ba gsal gdab/ rlung gi gnad 'og sgo a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum gyi tha ma la 'then pas sum mdo'i me sbar te/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ las me kha dog dmar ba/ ngo bo tsha ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pa ste chos sum ldan dang por sor gcig tsam/ de nas sor gnyis/ de nas sor gsum/ de nas sor bzhi tsam rno ba myur ba 'bar ba la sems gtad/ rlung rim gyis kha sbyar la bsgom/ des lte ba'i 'og tu drod tsha 'ur gyis 'ong ba la sogs pa nyams gang skyes kyang ngo shes par bya/ rjes lta ba bskyang ba sogs 'dra/ nyams myong skye sla ba'i dmigs pa yin pas rno ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis la brten pa ni lus gnad 'dra/ sngar lte ba'i 'khor lo'i steng du snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ sngo skya dngul chu lta bu mgo bo thur la lta ba 'thig la khad pa 'dab ma brgyad la yi ge dgod pa dang bral ba/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang lte ba'i aṃ gnyis rtsa dbu ma shin tu cha phra bas zung sbrel ba nang gi he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bor bsams la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ las me shin tu phra ba glog gi zer ma lta bu zhig dbu ma'i nang nas song ste/

hūm̐ la reg pas hūm̐ las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun shin tu phra ba zhig 'dzag nas aṃ la thim pas aṃ drag ru 'bar ba'i 'bar 'dzag dkar dmar 'dres pa la sems gtad/ rlung rim gyis kha sbyar/ lus dang sems gnyis ka bsgrims la bsgom/ rjes lta ba skyang ba sogs 'dra/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa brtan pa ni/ spyir 'khor lo rnams kyi gnas tshul/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo wa gshor lta bu/ lte ba sgro gu bcings pa lta bu/ snying ga pad+ma bye ba lta bu/ mgrin pa thal mo gyen la bkan pa lta bu/ spyi bo gdugs phub pa lta bur gnas zhes gsungs la/ lam du byed pa'i tshe lte ba dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo pad+ma kha gyen du bye ba lta bu dang*/ snying ga dang spyi bo'i 'khor lo gdugs phub pa lta bur bsam mo/ /nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ lus kyi gnad tsog pu/ sems kyi gnad las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis sngar ltar gsal gdab/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su aṃ/ nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la g.yas skor du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad/ phyi skor gyi 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i mdun nas g.yon skor gyis ā li bcu drug pa phrag gnyis/ g.yas skor gyis kā li ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa phrag gcig ste/ thams cad kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la blta ba/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog nag po mgo thur la blta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su oṃ/ 'dab ma rnams la ā li bcu drug g.yon skor/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la blta ba spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i dbus su haṃ/ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas g.yon skor gyis ā li bcu drug /g.yas skor gyis ka nas ta rnal ma'i bar yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po mgo thur la blta ba/

g.yas ro ma dmar mo kha gyen la blta ba/ g.yon rkyang ma dkar mo kha thur la blta ba/ dbus kun 'dar ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can te rtsa gsum po 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su 'dzom zhing spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du srog shing gi tshul du gnas par bsams la gsal gdab/ thebs pa na 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas aṃ dmar hur gyis 'bar te/ me lce phra mo glog gi zer ma lta bu zhig g.yas ro ma nas song*/ snying ga'i yig 'bru'i khams zhen thogs med par bcom/ yang ro ma nas song mgrin pa'i yig 'bru'i khams rnams bcom/ yang ro ma nas song spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ mgrin pa'i yig 'bru rnams gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ yang g.yon rkyang ma nas song*/ snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ yang rkyang ma nas song ste lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas aṃ gsos te cher 'bar bas dbu ma cung zad kha bye nas me lce shin tu cha phra ba glog gi zer ma'i tshul gyis dbu ma nas yar song ste snying ga hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ gnyis zhen thogs med par bcom ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun cha phra ba dbu ma nyid nas babs te/ me de rim gyis bdas nas mgrin pa'i gnas su 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad/ yang rim gyis bdas nas snying ga'i gnas su 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad/ yang rim gyis bdas nas lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam gyi gnas su yid 'jug pa'i sar 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de 'bar ba drags na yar ded/ 'dzag pa drags na mar ded de/ dkar dmar skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems drag tu gtad cing rlung rim gyis kha sbyar la bsgom mo/ /rjes lta ba bskyang ba sogs 'dra/ gsum pa man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba la/ me dmar skya/

me 'bar ba/ thig le'i 'thab mo/ me'i 'khor lo/ me drag tu 'bar ba/ me cher 'bar ba/ thams cad mer 'bar ba la dmigs pa dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ nus na maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang la/ nyams su len pa'i tshe bsam gtan gyi yan lag gzhan thams cad sngar bzhin la/ lus kyi gnad thabs 'gal gyi phyag rgya bco brgyad bca' ste/ de yang lus gnad tsog pur byas la sgom thag bcug /rkang pa'i long bu gnyis bsnol la lag pa gnyis kyang bsnol te dpung pa la 'khyud pas gru gsum drug 'byung ste/ phyi dbyibs kyi thabs 'gal drug /de bzhin du rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi la yang drug drug ste bco brgyad dam/ zhib tu rtsis na rlung la yang yod gsungs/ sems kyi gnad rang gi lus khog stong du dmigs la/ de'i nang du gang nas byung cha med par me dmar skya zhig lhab kyis byung ste lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam zhing shes pa me la drag tu gtad/ rlung gi gnad 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ steng rlung ran tshad du mnan la yid kyis grangs bzung ste mi thub na dal bus gtang*/ de lta bu'i grangs can bcu gnyis dang*/ yid kyis grangs ma bzung ba'i grangs med bcu gnyis sbrel te/ thun re la rlung sbyor nyi shu rtsa bzhi re bar ma chad par bsgoms la lam sbyang*/ sngar bzhin lta ba bskyang*/ nyams byung rgyal du la dor/ thun grangs yod de thun bzhi/ thun tshod yod de rlung sbyor nyer bzhi/ yid 'jug yul mi brtag /khams tshod kyang mi gzung*/ zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bskul te man ngag gi gnad 'di rnams 'og ma drug la'ang shes par bya'o/ /me 'bar ba la bslab pa ni/ gzhan thams cad sngar dang 'dra ba las rkang mthil gnyis su raṃ dmar nag re bsam/ rkang pa'i sor mo rnams cung zad bsgul bas rkang mthil na rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rlung g.yos pas raṃ las me 'bar ba long bu gnyis kyi nang na yar song brla'i rtsa bo che gnyis nas brgyud de sum mdor 'dzom pa'i me rno ba ste rgya khab kyi rtse lta bu/

myur ba ste mar me rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu/ drag pa ste me stag phroṃm phroṃm 'phro ba/ rtsub pa ste reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i chos bzhi ldan la dmigs pa gtad/ rlung gi gnad grangs can bcu gnyis dang*/ grangs med bcu gnyis spel ba sogs 'dra'o/ /thig le'i 'thab mo ni/ sngar gyi dmigs pa gzhir byas te me'i rtse mor thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig dang*/ de'i steng du sor bzhi tsam du thig le dmar po ril ma tsam zhig bsam ste/ rlung bzung bas thig le steng mas 'og ma la thug rgyab ste/ thig le gnyis yang yang 'thabs pa'i mtshams nas me stag phrom 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba la yid gtad do/ /me'i 'khor lo la dmigs pa ni/ sngar gyi me de drang thad yod pa'i steng du thig le dkar dmar gnyis brtsegs pa srog shing lta bu/ de'i steng du me'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa gcig bsgoms te/ de 'khor bar bsam pa'am/ yang na rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs re re la ā li ring thung gnyis kyi mgo nang du bstan pa ste/ phyi yig 'bru'i gnad/ bar 'khor lo'i gnad/ nang srog shing gi gnad de/ gnad gsum ldan du gsal gdab/ de lta bu'i 'khor lo de lus la ma reg par g.yas g.yon gang rung du 'khor bas lus kyi nang thams cad me stag dmar phrom phrom gang bar bsam/ 'di man chad la rlung kha sbyar du bya/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /me drag tu 'bar ba ni/ me'i 'khor lo'i steng du me kha dog dmar nag ngo bo tsha ba rang bzhin mnyen pa ste chos gsum ldan me stag dmar phroṃ phroṃ 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ spyi bo'i ya thod la thug gi bar 'bar bar bsam mo/ /me cher 'bar ba ni/ me de cher 'bar ba spyi bo nas thur du log ste lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me 'bar bar bsam mo/ /thams cad mer 'bar ba ni/ me de je che je cher song ste snang dmigs kyi dngos po thams cad gtum mo'i me chos gsum ldan du 'bar bar bsam mo/

/rjes lta ba bskyang ba la sogs pa thams cad sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa de dag gi skabs su dgos pa'i man ngag gi gnad ni/ khrid yig jo lcags ma las/ 'di rnams kyi skabs su bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung ba dang*/ gdams ngag drug gi gnad kyang 'di skabs su dgos pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'di khams 'dus pa dang por 'gro ste/ srung ba sum cu dang*/ gegs sel rnams kyang lhus che bar 'di dag gi skabs su dgos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bogs 'byin brgyad ni/ lus sems bsgrims glod gnyis res 'jog /thun dbri bskyed gnyis res 'jog kha zas res 'jog dang spyod lam bag yangs res 'jog /sems kyi gnad ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs su 'pho ba/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ste brgyad po 'di yin la/ gdams ngag drug ni/ lta sgom gnyis la so sor dug dbyung*/ bdud rtsi bsten la dor ba rnams yin zhing nyams su blang tshul gdams ngag drug gi yig chung las shes par bya/ srung ba sum cu ni/ don bsdus ma las/ thabs la dad pa la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad/ shes rab sad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung*/ /nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi'i brda yis bzlog /gnyis ka'i thun mong srung ba bcu bzhi ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba la dad sogs kyi srung ba brgyad/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba la sad pa bzhi dang dbang bzhi'i brdas srung ba ste brgyad/ gnyis ka la thun mong grib ma drug /'dzag pa drug sgrib pa gnyis srung ba dang bcas pas srung ba sum cur 'gyur zhing*/ de las 'phros pa'i gegs sel gyi man ngag thams cad kyang skabs 'di rnams su sbyar la nyams su len tshul shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lam de bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lta ba rang byung gi ye shes ni/ rtsa yi ge la gnad du bsnun pa las skye/ nang sems kyi steng du skye/ rang gi ngo bo gsal bar skye'o/

/de la bzhi ste/ nyon mongs rang byung*/ rnam rtog rang byung*/ snrel zhi rang byung*/ gsal zhing yang la mi rtog pa rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin no/ / dang po ni/ snying ga'i rigs lnga'i yi ge'am/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge lngar rlung sems dang por 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis dug lnga rang rgyud la skye/ gzhan rgyud la skyes par snang*/ dug lnga 'joms pa'i mthong snang dang rmi nyams 'byung la/ de byung rgyal du bskyangs pa nyid kyis gsal stong skyon med skye/ gsang 'dus las/ nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam rtog rang byung ni/ ro rkyang gi mas snar rlung sems dang por 'dus pas rlung spu gri stobs 'phel te gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog shin tu rags par song nas/ shes pa skad cig kyang mi gnas/ tha na gnyid kyang 'chag pa 'byung la/ de byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gsal stong skyon med du 'gro /rtsa rgyud las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa 'dag /ces gsungs/ snrel zhi rang byung ni/ sngar rlung sems 'du 'phro byed ma myong ba'i dbu ma la brten pa'i rtsa sna khong stong lta bur/ rlung sems dang po 'dus pas shes pa gsal cha chung zhing gnas cha che ba'i zhi gnas lteng po skye la/ de byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gsal stong skyon med du 'gro/ saṃ ṭi las/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar na dang po gnyis ni rgod pas bsdus la/ tha ma 'di ni bying bas bsdus pa'i phyir tha mal pa'i bying rgod dang dbye dka' bas skyon can zhes btags kyang*/ don ting nge 'dzin yin pas skyong shes na skyon med skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /gsal zhing yang la mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes ni/ zung 'jug gi hūm̐ du rlung sems 'dus pas shes pa gsal zhing yang ba chos kyi sku'i ye shes lta bu'i nyams skye/

rang byung ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ / chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs/'di goms pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur bas skyon med ces bya'o/ / skyon med ma skyes na bskyed pa'i thabs ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du 'gro bas/ mig bar snang la mi 'dzum par blta zhing shes pa rtsol ba lhod kyis glod la gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes chos gsum ldan du yang dang yang du dran pa'i ngang nas bzo med lhug par bzhag pas gsal stong mchog tu gyur pa mi skye mi srid gsungs so/ /gsum pa grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba rang byung gi ye shes goms pa la brten nas 'das lam sa bdun pa nas bcu pa'i bar la rigs drug gi skad shes/ de'i skad du chos ston/ ā li kā li la dbang thob/ tshig gi mchog 'grub/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la dbang 'byor/ tha snyad las sad tshangs pa'i dbyangs su 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan rgyud la 'char ba ste/ mdor na don dang tha snyad sna tshogs ma 'dres par so sor shes shing yongs su rdzogs par ngag gcig gis gzhan la ston nus pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'da' ka ma 'od gsal ba ni/ gal te tshe 'di la grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na 'da' ka ma'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ 'chi ka'i dus su dbugs rtseg pas rkyen byas nas las kyi rlung nang du bzlog ste khyab byed kyi rlung gtso bor rgyu bas rtsa phran bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i rlung dang*/ byang sems kyi stobs thams cad rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis phrog /de rnams kyi stobs kyang 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i rtsa brgya nyi shus phrog /de rnams kyi stobs kyang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa dang snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad de sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis phrogs nas rlung thams cad yan lag la lhung bas yan lag gi sor mo re re yang lci yor byed/

rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi stobs kyang ro rkyang gnyis kyis phrogs pas dbugs shin tu rgod/ nyi zla'i rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyi stobs kyang sgra gcan gyi rtsa dbu mas phrogs te sa chu la thim pas dbang po'i sgo thams cad gsher/ chu me la thim pas kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pas skyigs bu 'byung*/ zug gzer che/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas zug zhi/ mig gyen la zlog /shes pas yul mi 'dzin/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim rlung dang byang chub kyi sems thams cad dbu mar zhugs te/ rlung gi nus pas stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skye la/ de la 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku'am/ 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa'am/ 'chi ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /de sems can thams cad la 'byung yang phal cher gyis ngo mi shes shing rnal 'byor pa zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyon med skyes pa zhig yin la/ sngar 'dris pa'i mi dang 'phrad pa ltar ngo shes te/ gzhi la gnas pa'i 'od gsal ma dang*/ sgom stobs kyis myangs pa'i 'od gsal bu gnyis gcig tu 'dres nas/ don gyi 'od gsal zhes bya ba bar do med par grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur la/ sngar lam bsgoms pa'i tshe lta ba la goms 'dris cung zad yod kyang*/ zung 'jug skyon med kyi ye shes ma skyes pa zhig yin na skabs 'dir dpe'i 'od gsal tsam mngon du byas te bar do med par rig pa 'dzin pa'i nam mkha' la spyod pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ skyon med kyi lta ba bskyed pa'i thabs nyid la nan tan du byas pa las byung ba'i nyams myong gi lta ba bar ma chad par bskyangs te goms 'dris brtan nas mthar 'chi ba la nye bar gyur pa na bu pha khyim du 'gro ba ltar brod pa'i 'du shes nyid nye bar bzhag ste/'chi ba la 'jigs pa dang skrag pa la sogs pa'i blo cung zad kyang med par byas la/ bdag gis 'chi ba 'od gsal la 'od gsal nyid du ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag po yang dang yang du btang ste/

nyams myong lta ba la lhug par 'jog ci thub kyi ngang nas 'khrul snang gi dbang du ma shor bar bya ba nyid yin no/ /lnga pa bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la rtog med ni/ gal te 'da' ka ma mi thebs pa 'dra na/ gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do'i gdams ngag dgos pas/ de sbyang ba'i tshul la gnyis las/ sngon 'gro ni/ bdag la nang rang byung gi ye shes ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gsung rdo rje longs sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba rang byung gi ye shes dran pa ste gsum 'brel ba can du dus kyi nges pa gcig la dran par bya ste/ rmi lam gyi rkyen gyis kyang de gsum dran pa ma byung gi bar du bslab bo/ /dngos gzhi ni/ de ltar goms pa'i dbang gis bar do'i rkyen bdun shar ba na yang sngar gyi dran pa gsum 'byung zhing*/ bsnam bya yang ā li'i rnam par shar te/ rten 'brel des snang ba dang bdag gi sems ro gcig tu gyur nas bar do de nyid du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub ni 'bras bu'i skabs nyid du 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba la/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs kyi lam/ lta ba lhan cig skyes pa yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ 'da' kha ma nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ zhar byung bar do lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub ste drug gi dang po la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bsags sbyang gnyis sngar bstan pa bzhin las/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor gyi mthar bla ma rang la bstim ste snying ga'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/

gsal stong phyogs med ris med mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa ste/ nges pa don gyi bla ma yi dam dbyer med du shes par byas la/ de la gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal dbul te/ de yang don yid la dran bzhin pas/ chos dbyings sa gzhir snying rje'i rlan gyis byugs/ /sems nyid lhun po tshad med gling bzhis brgyan/ /zung 'jug nyi zla gzhan don 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /chos sku'i lo tog gzugs sku'i phrin las sogs/ /dpag bsam shing 'bras lha mi'i longs spyo kun/ /rang sems bla mar snang ba'i slob dpon la/ /gus pas 'bul gyis mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha sogs sngar bzhin brjod la ci nus phul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu rgyas bsdus gnyis po gang rigs sngar bzhin las bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs kyi tshig /thugs kyi rdo rje chos sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /lhan skyes ston mdzad gsang ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so sems la gsum pa stsol/ /pho nya'i lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ /bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na/ / rdor sems 'byon pa'i 'pho ba thebs par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na/ /lhan skyes bde ba bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs 'grub ste/ /chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lam rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ rig ma dag pa/ lus ngag mnyam pa/ byin rlabs mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa/ man ngag gi gnad kyis zin pa'o/ /dang po la dngos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ste ye shes kyi rig ma zhig yid kyi yul du bya'o/
